Title: Vehicle Propulsion Systems Engineering

Apply strong data governance practices: data quality checks, metadata standards, lineage, and documentation. Support model and pipeline validation for data integrity, reliability, and production readiness. Build dashboards and reports that highlight trends, anomalies, and operational insights for engineering teams. Collaborate with calibration, controls, test, IT, and cybersecurity stakeholders to define and deliver requirements. Contribute to DevSecOps practices by integrating security scanning, secret management, and release controls into CI/CD. Monitor production services and pipelines using Cloud Logging, Monitoring, and alerting, and support incident response. Ensure compliance with enterprise data security, cybersecurity, and operational standards. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field. Experience 1-5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, data analysis, or data science. Hands-on delivery experience with data processing, analysis, and visualization. Experience with cloud-based analytics or data platforms; GCP experience strongly preferred. Automotive and powertrain data experience is a strong advantage. Core Data and Analytics Python proficiency for data transformation, automation, and analytics workflows. Strong SQL skills for extraction, transformation, and analytical querying. Solid understanding of ETL/ELT, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts. Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Qlik. Ability to analyze large and complex datasets and produce actionable engineering insights. Version control proficiency with Git and collaborative branching/review workflows. GCP Technologies (High Emphasis) Cloud Storage: bucket architecture, IAM controls, lifecycle rules, retention policies, event notifications, and storage classes. Cloud Functions: event-driven development, deployment, observability, retry handling, and idempotent processing. Tekton: pipeline authoring, reusable tasks, triggers, artifact traceability, automated tests, approvals, and promotion gates. BigQuery and Pub/Sub: ingestion, transformation, and event-stream integration in analytics workflows. Identity and Access Management (IAM): least-privilege role design, service account scoping, and access governance. Security controls: Secret Manager, Cloud KMS, audit logging, and secure configuration baselines. Monitoring and reliability: Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Error Reporting, and alert-driven operations. Infrastructure as Code: Terraform or equivalent for repeatable GCP provisioning. DevOps and Cybersecurity CI/CD implementation for analytics and data products across dev, test, and prod environments. DevSecOps integration including dependency scanning, secret scanning, and policy checks in pipelines. Release management with rollback strategy, quality gates, and deployment governance. Working knowledge of cloud threat detection and security posture management principles. Collaboration Skills (Soft Skills) Strong written and verbal communication; clear technical documentation and stakeholder reporting. Structured problem solving with accountability and attention to root-cause analysis. High learning agility and adaptability in fast-evolving cloud and analytics environments. Effective cross-functional collaboration in global teams. Detail orientation and ownership mindset for data quality, reliability, and security.

Title: Pricing Analyst, Americas, CASTROL
Description: Job Family Group Marketing Group Job Description The Pricing Analyst is responsible for maintaining and executing product pricing strategies across multiple customer channels and lubricant product lines. The role manages pricing data in SAP and related systems, ensuring compliance with financial governance standards while supporting Sales, Finance, Operations, Marketing, and customers. Key responsibilities include pricing analysis, market and competitor monitoring, price implementation, reporting, process improvement, and system optimization. The Pricing Analyst works cross-functionally to translate business objectives into pricing actions, resolve pricing issues, and provide insights that drive revenue, profitability, and pricing performance. Execute and maintain product and customer pricing within pricing/ERP systems, including price changes, product setup, and discount/rebate structures, ensuring alignment with governance frameworks. Support price change execution processes in SAP ECC/ERP systems, including identifying impacted customers and products, executing changes (using existing or creating templates) and validation checks to ensure accurate implementation. Translate commercial strategies and business objectives into accurate, system-ready pricing instructions. Analyze market trends, competitive landscape, and customer behavior to identifyopportunities for pricing optimization. Execute pricing changes to optimize volume, revenue, and profitability. Develop pricing strategies to support new and existing products. Develop and maintain pricing frameworks across customers, products, and channels within Castrol’s strategic and operational pricing environments, including list price, discounts, promotions, surcharges, and rebates. Perform pricing analysis on volume, price, discount, rebate, and cost components to support financial performance insights and business decision-making. Build and maintain financial and data models and reports (Excel required; Power BI preferred) to analyze price/discount/margin relationships, margin performance, and pricing scenarios (e.g., variance analysis across price waterfalls). Develop dashboards and reporting (Power BI or equivalent) to provide visibility into pricing performance, KPIs, and key commercial insights for stakeholders. Identify, investigate, and resolve pricing system issues, conflicts, and data inconsistencies; escalate and recommend solutions as needed. Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, and Operations to understand commercial objectives of price changes and report and summarize change outcomes. Understand and report information in a language consistent with a P&L, including gross revenue, discounts, rebates, allowances, net revenue, COGS, gross profit, and operating expenses. Drive continuous improvement by identifying automation opportunities, simplifying processes, and enhancing pricing system capabilities. Ability to improve pricing-change speed-to-market is key. Document pricing processes and support knowledge transfer to ensure continuity and operational resilience. Support development and evaluation of customer offers by providing pricing analysis, profitability insights, and reporting outputs for various B2B and B2B2C routes to market. Additional Responsibilities Include Pricing System Thought Leadership - ability to identify, recommend, and drive improvement efforts. Technical knowledge resource - able to consult, troubleshoot, and recommend pricing system solutions whenever there are business or system inquiries. Able to prioritize objectives when there are competing priorities. Able to identify areas of high value automation to reduce the complexity/increase pricing speed to market. Able to make judgement calls on pricing recommendations, especially where there’s multiple sources of information affecting the decision. Education Bachelor of Data Science, Business Analytics, Business Intelligence, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or Engineering Experience 5+ years of experience in Pricing or closely related function 3+ years of SAP ECC/ERP system hands-on execution experience Highly skilled in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel Power BI or similar data model and dashboard building experience Skills & Competencies Ability to take charge and lead cross-functional teams.
